newsitem.title: UK: ORANGE INDICATED UP AS PRE-TAX LOSS NARROWS.
newsitem.headline: ORANGE INDICATED UP AS PRE-TAX LOSS NARROWS.

text.p: Shares in Orange Plc rose in pre-market trading after first-half results came in better than most expected and it announced a doubling in its network investments, dealers said.
By 0721 GMT, shares in Orange, Britain's third biggest mobile telephone company, were up 5-1/2p at 217-1/2p, near its year's best of 228p touched in May.
Orange's pre-tax loss narrowed by 41 percent to 73.5 million stg, while analysts had forecast the loss in a range between 73 and 103 million stg.
Investment in its network will double to 800 million stg so it can introduce new services to help win new customers, Orange said.

Britain's youngest mobile telephone company also said that earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) became positive for the first time, at 12 million stg, from a loss of 70 million stg in the first half of 1996.
